facts.text: Mercedes win the constructors’ title in all 20,000 of our simulated seasons, but have not clinched it: it is not yet mathematically decided, and 47 more points would settle it whatever the others do.
Mercedes lead the constructors’ championship by 126 points with 4 races left.
Mercedes have 630 points after 19 rounds, against 341 at this point of 2025.
The best car on qualifying pace in F1 this season (−1.015%).
Antonelli has scored 380 of Mercedes’ 630 points (60%).
